historical_reviews.v3_1: Separates read-only update-service discovery from firmware inventory enumeration and from every state-changing update action.

original_test_intent: Read the Redfish UpdateService root and confirm the service resource is readable and error-free.
original_method: Follow the UpdateService link advertised by the Redfish service root, perform one read-only GET over verified TLS and validate the complete service document without following upload or update actions.
manual_activity: Supply the target UpdateService schema/link, read-only credential handle, trusted CA bundle and policy for retaining update endpoint or image metadata.
safety_requirements: No hardcoded credentials or unapproved TLS bypass
Do not follow upload URIs or Actions
Never invoke SimpleUpdate, StartUpdate, reset or activation
Redact repository/image endpoint metadata as required
Do not infer firmware compliance from service availability
agent_execution_scope: Use secret-backed read-only authentication and verified TLS
Capture status, headers and complete JSON
Validate identity, schema, ServiceEnabled and FirmwareInventory link
Enumerate but do not call mutation-capable links

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The GET endpoint is appropriate, but projecting only ServiceEnabled and FirmwareInventory discards action/capability fields needed to prove the complete response, while `-k` and exposed credentials violate transport controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover and GET UpdateService securely once, retain the complete response hash, validate schema and required fields, produce a redacted link/capability summary and never dereference mutation-capable targets.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The UpdateService root and 15/10 timing are preserved; no enabled value, inventory population, update method or target version is assumed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate UpdateService as a read-only capability document with complete evidence and an explicit barrier around action and upload links.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds service-root identity binding, verified transport, secret-safe credentials, full schema validation and action-link classification while preserving logs.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Confirms UpdateService availability, status and advertised links only; it does not enumerate every firmware member or test image transfer, update, activation, rollback or reset.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: ServiceEnabled may not guarantee that every advertised update mode works, and OEM action fields can reveal infrastructure or require a firmware-specific schema.

project_override_considerations: If ServiceEnabled is absent or not applicable in the target schema, validate the schema-defined service status instead and record the deviation. Treat upload endpoints as sensitive strings, not executable instructions.
expected_evidence: No upload/update/reset action and preserved logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, Criteria and Script consistently request a read-only UpdateService root query. The source is insecure and underspecified but does not contradict the named operation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The access, trust and schema inputs are ordinary read-only package requirements, so there is no unresolved engineering definition preventing review completion.

review_improvement: Preserves the entire UpdateService capability document for audit, validates its inventory link and prevents discovery of update functions from becoming accidental firmware mutation.
independent_technical_reasoning: UpdateService is unusually safety-sensitive even when queried with GET because its response typically advertises upload targets and actions that can alter firmware and trigger resets. The agent must classify those links without following them. A two-field projection cannot prove that the response was the correct resource or reveal unexpected mutation-capable extensions, so the complete response needs protected hashing and schema validation. Conversely, a valid service root does not prove any image is compatible or any update path is operational.
